_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.vi: Đọc TH thành T: "thank" nghe thành "tank" (tiếng Indonesia không có âm TH)
mistake.l1: Indonesian has no /θ/, so learners use /t/.

segments.text: Thank, or tank? The first sound is different.
Thank. Put your tongue between your teeth. Thank.
Tank. Touch the top of your mouth with your tongue. Tank.
Repeat after me. Thank you. A big tank.

native.caption: Banyak penutur bahasa Indonesia mengucapkan T untuk TH, sehingga “thank” terdengar seperti “tank”. Untuk TH, letakkan lidah di antara gigi; untuk T, sentuhkan lidah ke langit-langit mulut. Ulangi bersama Carlos dan latihan pengucapan di aplikasi Lexkite.

en.caption: Many Indonesian speakers say T instead of TH, so “thank” sounds like “tank”. For TH, put your tongue between your teeth; for T, touch the top of your mouth. Repeat after Carlos and practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
